aboutSubheading: Serving Melbourne's Northern Suburbs for Over 15 Years
aboutText: Botterill Electrics has been proudly serving Reservoir and the wider Melbourne community for over 15 years. Our licensed electricians deliver reliable, high-quality electrical solutions for homes and businesses across the northern suburbs. From simple repairs to complete rewires, we've built our reputation on honest advice and exceptional workmanship.

servicesSubheading: Professional Electrical Solutions for Every Need
servicesText: Botterill Electrics offers a comprehensive range of electrical services for residential and commercial properties. Whether you need a simple power point installed or a complete switchboard upgrade, our experienced team delivers quality results every time.

services.title: New Installations
services.desc: Expert installation of power points, lighting, ceiling fans, and appliances for your home or business.

services.title: Fault Finding
services.desc: Quick and accurate diagnosis of electrical faults to get your systems back up and running safely.

services.title: Switchboard Upgrades
services.desc: Modernise your switchboard with safety switches and circuit breakers to protect your property and family.

services.title: Solar Installations
services.desc: Harness the power of the sun with quality solar panel systems designed for Australian conditions.

services.title: EV Charger Installation
services.desc: Future-proof your home with a professionally installed electric vehicle charging station.

services.title: Fire & Safety Systems
services.desc: Installation and maintenance of smoke alarms and fire detection systems to keep your property compliant.
